SELECT C001 + C002 + C003 + C004 + C005 + C006 AS TOT_COUNT , C003 + C004 AS FLAG1 , C002 AS FLAG2 , C001 AS FLAG3 , C005 AS FLAG4 , C006 AS FLAG5 FROM (
SELECT SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C001' , 1 , 0)) C001 , SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C002' , 1 , 0)) C002 , SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C003' , 1 , 0)) C003 , SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C004' , 1 , 0)) C004 , SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C005' , 1 , 0)) C005 , SUM(DECODE(CM.CUST_GUBUN , 'C006' , 1 , 0)) C006 FROM CRM_CUST_MGT CM, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI WHERE CM.SEQ = COI.SEQ AND COI.DEAL_CODE IN ('C001','C002') AND COI.HIS_YN ='Y' ) IN_TB

WITH A AS(SELECT COUNT(CM.SEQ) CNT ,COI.DEAL_CODE CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT CM, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI WHERE 1=1 AND CM.SEQ(+) = COI.SEQ AND COI.HIS_YN ='Y'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN IN('C003','C004')
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C005'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C006'
GROUP BY COI.DEAL_CODE ), B AS ( SELECT 'C001' AS CODE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'C002' AS CODE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'C003' AS CODE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'C005' AS CODE FROM DUAL ) SELECT NVL(CNT,'0')CNT, B.CODE, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03'AND Z.CODE = B.CODE) CODE_NAME FROM A,B WHERE 1=1 AND A.CODE(+) = B.CODE ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT SUM(FLAG1) AS FLAG1 --무상 계약만료 ,SUM(FLAG2) AS FLAG2 --유상 계약만료 FROM ( SELECT 0 AS FLAG1 --무상 ,COUNT(*) AS FLAG2 --유상 FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A ,CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO B ,(SELECT * FROM KYERP.TB_FI_AUTO_BILL D WHERE D.HAEJI_FG = 'N' --해지:N AND D.POST_CODE = '63100' --부서:MA사업팀 AND D.CODE_ITEM = 'C300000001' --품목:ONTIC HIS 유보료 )C WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.CUST_CODE = C.CUST_CODE(+) AND B.HIS_YN = 'Y' AND B.DEAL_CODE = 'C002' AND C.END_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS FLAG1 --무상 ,0 AS FLAG2 --유상 FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A --Lineus 거래처 마스터 테이블 ,CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO B --Lineus 거래처 운영정보 테이블 ,KYERP.TB_SD_MAINT_MST C --ERP 무상계약 테이블 WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.CUST_CODE = C.CUST_CODE(+) AND B.HIS_YN = 'Y' AND B.DEAL_CODE IN ('C001') AND C.MAINT_END_DATE < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')
)

SELECT SUM(DECODE(IN_TB.DEAL_CODE , 'C001' , 1 , 0)) FLAG1, SUM(DECODE(IN_TB.DEAL_CODE , 'C002' , 1 , 0)) FLAG2 FROM(SELECT CM.SEQ , CM.CRM_CODE, COI.DEAL_CODE FROM CRM_CUST_MGT CM, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI WHERE 1=1 AND CM.SEQ = COI.SEQ AND COI.DEAL_CODE IN('C001','C002') AND COI.HIS_YN = 'Y'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN IN('C003','C004')
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C005'
AND CM.CUST_GUBUN = 'C006'
) IN_TB,CRM_CUST_MAINTENANCE_HIST_CC CC WHERE 1=1 AND IN_TB.CRM_CODE = CC.CRM_CODE(+) AND CC.BILL_CODE = #{search_type1} AND CC.MTAC_END_DT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY F.FLAG4 ) AS RNUM ,F.* FROM ( SELECT CRM_CODE ,E.CUST_KOR_NAME ,E.CUST_ADDRESS ,E.DEAL_CODE ,E.DEAL_CODE_NAME ,E.BILL_CODE ,E.MTAC_START_DT ,E.MTAC_END_DT ,E.HIS_TREAT_CODE ,E.HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM ,E.CANCEL_DT --해지일 ,E.ITEM_NM ,E.FLAG1 ,E.FLAG2 ,CASE WHEN FLAG1 <> '0'AND FLAG2 <> '0' THEN TRUNC(FLAG2 / FLAG1*100) WHEN FLAG1 IS NULL AND FLAG2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END FLAG3 ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TO_DATE(E.MTAC_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') --계약기간이 남았으면 THEN (TO_DATE(E.MTAC_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(E.MTAC_START_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') ) - (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(E.MTAC_START_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) WHEN FLAG1 IS NULL AND FLAG2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END FLAG4
FROM (SELECT A.CRM_CODE ,A.CUST_KOR_NAME ,SUBSTR(A.CUST_ADDRESS, 1, (INSTR(A.CUST_ADDRESS, ' ')-1)) CUST_ADDRESS ,B.DEAL_CODE --HIS 거래상태 ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST'AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = B.DEAL_CODE)DEAL_CODE_NAME ,DECODE(C.CODE_ITEM, 'C300000001', 'C001', 'C300000005', 'C004', 'C300000006', 'C006', 'C009') AS BILL_CODE ,C.ST_DATE AS MTAC_START_DT --계약 시작일 ,C.END_DATE AS MTAC_END_DT --계약 종료일 ,B.HIS_TREAT_CODE --진료버전 코드 ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_TREAT_CODE) HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM ,TO_DATE(C.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(C.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') FLAG1 ,CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TO_DATE(C.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(C.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_DATE(C.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(C.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END FLAG2 ,B.CANCEL_DT ,C.CODE_ITEM ,(SELECT Z.ITEM_NM FROM KYERP.TB_CM_ITEM_MST Z WHERE C.CODE_ITEM = Z.ITEM_CD ) ITEM_NM FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A ,CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO B ,(SELECT D.PK_SEQ ,D.CUST_CODE ,D.EMP_NO ,D.POST_CODE ,D.CODE_ITEM ,D.SUPP_AMT ,D.VAT ,D.ST_DATE ,D.END_DATE ,D.GYEYAG_IL ,D.HAEJI_FG FROM KYERP.TB_FI_AUTO_BILL D WHERE 1=1
AND D.HAEJI_FG = 'N' --유상이면 해지:N
AND D.HAEJI_FG = 'Y' --중지,해지,폐업 이면 해지:Y
AND D.POST_CODE = '63100' --부서:MA사업팀 AND D.CODE_ITEM = 'C300000001' --품목:ONTIC HIS 유보료 )C WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.CUST_CODE = C.CUST_CODE(+) AND B.HIS_YN = 'Y' AND B.DEAL_CODE = #{search_type2} -- C002:유상, C003:해지, C004:폐업, C005:중지
)E )F ORDER BY FLAG4, FLAG3 DESC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SORT_TB.FLAG4 ) AS RNUM, SORT_TB.* FROM(SELECT MAIN_TB.CRM_CODE , MAIN_TB.CUST_KOR_NAME , SUBSTR(MAIN_TB.CUST_ADDRESS, 1, (INSTR(MAIN_TB.CUST_ADDRESS, ' ')-1)) CUST_ADDRESS , COI.DEAL_CODE , (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = COI.DEAL_CODE)DEAL_CODE_NAME , MAIN_TB.BILL_CODE , MAIN_TB.MTAC_START_DT , MAIN_TB.MTAC_END_DT , COI.HIS_TREAT_CODE , (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05'AND Z.CODE = COI.HIS_TREAT_CODE) HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM, MAIN_TB.FLAG1, MAIN_TB.FLAG2, COI.CANCEL_DT, CASE WHEN FLAG1 <> '0' AND FLAG2 <> '0' THEN TRUNC(FLAG2 / FLAG1*100) WHEN FLAG1 IS NULL AND FLAG2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END FLAG3, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TO_DATE(MAIN_TB.MTAC_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN (TO_DATE(MAIN_TB.MTAC_END_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(MAIN_TB.MTAC_START_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') ) - (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(MAIN_TB.MTAC_START_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) WHEN FLAG1 IS NULL AND FLAG2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 0 END FLAG4, MAIN_TB.ITEM_NM FROM( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT OUT_TB.VW_PK ,OUT_TB.ERP_CODE ,DECODE(OUT_TB.ITEM_CD,'C300000001','C001','C300000005','C004','C300000006','C006','C009') AS BILL_CODE ,OUT_TB.TOT_AMT ,OUT_TB.ST_DATE AS MTAC_START_DT ,OUT_TB.END_DATE AS MTAC_END_DT ,TO_DATE(OUT_TB.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(OUT_TB.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') FLAG1, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TO_DATE(OUT_TB.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TO_DATE(OUT_TB.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_DATE(OUT_TB.END_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(OUT_TB.ST_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END FLAG2 , (SELECT Z.ITEM_NM FROM KYERP.TB_CM_ITEM_MST Z WHERE 1=1 AND OUT_TB.ITEM_CD = Z.ITEM_CD ) ITEM_NM FROM ( SELECT MAX(VW_PK) AS VW_PK , ERP_CODE , ITEM_CD FROM VW_CUST_MAINTENANCE_HIST GROUP BY ERP_CODE, ITEM_CD )IN_TB, VW_CUST_MAINTENANCE_HIST OUT_TB WHERE 1=1 AND IN_TB.VW_PK = OUT_TB.VW_PK )CON_TB,CRM_CUST_MGT CUS_TB WHERE 1=1 AND CON_TB.BILL_CODE(+) = #{search_type1} AND CUS_TB.ERP_CODE = CON_TB.ERP_CODE(+)
AND CUS_TB.CUST_GUBUN IN('C003','C004')
AND CUS_TB.CUST_GUBUN = 'C002'
AND CUS_TB.CUST_GUBUN = 'C001'
AND CUS_TB.CUST_GUBUN = 'C005'
AND CUS_TB.CUST_GUBUN = 'C006'
)MAIN_TB, CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO COI WHERE 1=1 AND MAIN_TB.SEQ = COI.SEQ AND COI.DEAL_CODE IN('C001','C002','C003','C005') AND COI.HIS_YN = 'Y' )SORT_TB WHERE 1=1 AND DEAL_CODE = #{search_type2} ORDER BY FLAG4

SELECT IN_TB.TOT_COUNT ,IN_TB.FLAG1 ,IN_TB.FLAG2 FROM(SELECT COUNT(AS_NO) TOT_COUNT, SUM(DECODE(CUST_CODE , #{search_type1} , 1 , 0)) FLAG1, SUM(CASE WHEN CUST_CODE = #{search_type1} AND PROC_STATUS ='C005' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FLAG2 FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND AS_NO BETWEEN #{search_type2} || '01000' AND #{search_type3} || '31999' AND DEL_YN IS NULL )IN_TB

SELECT IN_TB.SERVICE_CATE ,(SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = IN_TB.SERVICE_CATE)SERVICE_CATE_NM ,IN_TB.SERVICE_COUNT FROM(SELECT SERVICE_CATE, COUNT(SERVICE_CATE) SERVICE_COUNT FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND AS_NO BETWEEN #{search_type2} || '01000' AND #{search_type3} || '31999' AND CUST_CODE = #{search_type1} AND DEL_YN IS NULL GROUP BY SERVICE_CATE ORDER BY COUNT(SERVICE_CATE) DESC )IN_TB WHERE 1=1 AND ROWNUM < 6

SELECT COUNT(AS_NO)CNT, PROC_STATUS, (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD01' AND Z.CODE = PROC_STATUS) PROC_STATUS_NM FROM CRM_AS_MGT WHERE 1=1 AND CUST_CODE = #{search_type1} AND AS_NO BETWEEN #{search_type2} || '01000' AND #{search_type3} || '31999' AND DEL_YN IS NULL GROUP BY PROC_STATUS ORDER BY COUNT(AS_NO)

/* 메인 대시보드 엑셀 다운로드 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY C.DEAL_CODE, C.CRM_CODE ) AS RNUM , C.* FROM ( SELECT A.CUST_KOR_NAME , A.CRM_CODE , B.DEAL_CODE , (SELECT Z.CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD03' AND Z.CODE = B.DEAL_CODE) AS DEAL_CODE_NM , (SELECT CODE_NAME FROM CRM_CODE_DETAIL Z WHERE Z.CODE_GROUP = 'CUST' AND Z.P_CODE = 'CD05' AND Z.CODE = B.HIS_TREAT_CODE) AS HIS_TREAT_CODE_NM , SUBSTR(A.CUST_ADDRESS, 1, (INSTR(A.CUST_ADDRESS, ' ')-1)) CUST_ADDRESS FROM CRM_CUST_MGT A , CRM_CUST_OPERATE_INFO B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SEQ = B.SEQ AND B.HIS_YN = 'Y' )C
